examples.en: The committee agreed to revisit the issue at their next meeting.
examples.zh: 该委员会同意在他们下次会议上重新讨论这个问题。

examples.en: It has become so popular that whenever disasters happen, people revisit the song and find strength in it.
examples.zh: 这首歌很受欢迎，所以每当灾难发生时，人们都会重温这首歌，并从中找到力量。

examples.en: People can revisit and refocus an image, days, months, even years later.
examples.zh: 人们可以在几天、几个月、甚至几年后重新审视和调整图像。
